sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) documents unauthorized credit card fraud identified on customer account C13487. On 2016-11-22 16:11:00, flagged transaction 3478561 for $74.96 was detected via online channel with an elevated risk score of nan. Graph analytics and multi-hop link expansion revealed that the transaction was associated with device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080', which was identified across 51 additional cardholder accounts (C00255-K1, C01289-K1, C01935-K1). The cardholder, when contacted for transaction validation, confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and remained in possession of their physical card. The activity exhibits characteristics consistent with undocumented, where compromised credentials or card data were systematically exploited. Total cumulative fraudulent exposure across identified affected transactions (3478561) totals $74.96. The financial institution has taken immediate mitigating actions by blocking card C13487-K1 for reissue, opening internal case HHG-014 in graph memory, and placing all connected card accounts under continuous surveillance per Bank Policy R2, R6, and regulatory guidelines.

stop_reason: Multi-hop graph link analysis identified coordinated device sharing across multiple cards with anonymous proxy routing. Stop condition met per R6 and R9.
